placements.php-session-cookie-pointer-leak: objectives/execution/exploit/php-engine-uaf; requires PHPSESSID= literal, 64-bit pointer bounds (0x7f0000000000..0x7fffffffffff), and a little-endian 64-bit integer unpack call. The honeypot report records 819200-byte decoded PHPSESSID disclosures whose dominant pointer adjusted the follow-on execution body.
placements.php-zend-mm-chunk-aslr-slide: objectives/execution/exploit/php-engine-uaf; requires 2 MiB Zend MM chunk alignment mask (0x1fffff), zval_ptr_dtor and zif_system targets, and 64-bit word unpacking (exploit.py parse_leak / run_chain).
placements.php2shell-forged-zend-string-leak: objectives/execution/exploit/php-engine-uaf; requires the engine-mandated PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS token and dense little-endian packing plus zend_string layout or 0x1018 Zend MM page-1 string offset (mk_leak_b.py forge_value/progress_forge_value).
placements.php2shell-fake-zend-array-spray: objectives/execution/exploit/php-engine-uaf; requires upload progress, dense little-endian packing, and zend_array/zend_reference layouts or 0x0107 refcounted IS_ARRAY type_info (fake_ref_b.py spray before/after the session fields).
placements.php-fake-zend-array-execute-data: objectives/execution/exploit/php-engine-uaf; requires dense little-endian packing with zend_array and execute_data layouts aimed at zif_system/pDestructor (mk_ht.py 384-byte carrier).
placements.php-forged-zend-hashtable-carrier: objectives/execution/exploit/php-engine-uaf; requires dense little-endian packing with Zend HashTable 8-bucket nTableMask (0xfffffff8) and interned IS_STRING type_info (0x0106) aimed at zif_system/pDestructor/zend_array (mk_ht.py).

omitted: Apache prefork worker pinning (hold_workers): no confident general matcher beyond the sample's own help text; partial-request holding is also a load-testing shape.
OOM memory-pressure multipart floods (mk_a1.py/cheap_oom_a.py): field counts and filler sizes are tuning parameters of this build, and bulk multipart generation has legitimate fuzzing/load uses.
Exact body hashes, the ten-C boundary, q0000000 query, and per-build libphp offsets: sample/build fingerprints, recorded as indicators only.
